workload: Normal authenticated dashboard navigation and 20 consecutive reloads; summary/timeseries/diagnostics arrive concurrently; options retains its broader metadata selection
authoritativeTiming: Production HttpRequest durationMs; browser navigation time is separate and includes client work
percentile: Nearest-rank ceil(n*0.95), with n and maximum retained
idleCase: Separately observe one request after at least 65 seconds without app requests; do not present one cold request as a cold p95
limitation: A bounded representative workload does not establish a long-term production SLO or traffic-wide capacity. Keep cold and continuous-request results distinguishable.
